title: Thoth
html_source:
Egyptian deity. God of knowledge, wisdom, writing.

Plato wrote of an imagined meeting between Socrates and Phaedrus in

http://history.genius.com/Plato-phaedrus-full-text-annotated

Socrates discusses writing with Phaedrus through the medium of the Thoth myth during which writing is seen as a help and a hindrance; it being , according to the sun-god, an improvement but one which can sidestep individual centred experience for a borrowed memory.
